headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 20, 2026**
article:
The Chicago White Sox secured a dominant 3-0 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Sean Burke pitching 6.2 innings of scoreless baseball. Grant Taylor earned the save in the win. The Los Angeles Dodgers also secured a win, taking down the New York Yankees 8-2 behind Yoshinobu Yamamoto's 9.0 innings of work.

Injuries are piling up across the league, with several key players landing on the injured list. Phil Maton, a right-handed pitcher for the Chicago Cubs, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right knee tendinitis. The San Diego Padres have also placed DH Miguel Andujar on the 10-day injured list with a right wrist fracture.

The Colorado Rockies made a move on July 20, acquiring RHP Nick Frasso from the Los Angeles Dodgers in exchange for RHP Seth Halvorsen. The Chicago Cubs also made a trade, acquiring RHP Aaron Civale from the Athletics in exchange for RHP Aiden Moffett. The Baltimore Orioles acquired RF Rudy Martin Jr. from the Kansas City Royals in exchange for cash.

top_news.title: **White Sox Shut Out Blue Jays 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a dominant 3-0 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Sean Burke pitching 6.2 innings of scoreless baseball. Grant Taylor earned the save in the win.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Take Down Yankees 8-2**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers secured an 8-2 victory over the New York Yankees, with Yoshinobu Yamamoto earning the win after pitching 9.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 2 earned runs. Trent Grisham led the Dodgers' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Fall Short in Bronx Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees edged the Los Angeles Dodgers 2-1, securing a narrow victory. Tommy Edman led the Dodgers' offense with a home run and an RBI, while Alex Vesia impressed on the mound with three strikeouts in a scoreless inning.

top_news.title: **Rays Fall to Red Sox in 6-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, securing a 6-1 victory. Willson Contreras led the Rays' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cubs RHP Phil Maton Lands on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Chicago Cubs right-handed pitcher Phil Maton has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right knee tendinitis.

top_news.title: **Rockies Acquire Frasso in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies made a move on July 20, 2026, acquiring RHP Nick Frasso from the Los Angeles Dodgers in exchange for RHP Seth Halvorsen.
